verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a general-purpose web API for managing organizations, teams, and data export (sentry-docs-14, sentry-docs-20), plus MCP/CLI tooling for AI agents to interact with issues and projects (sentry-docs-2, sentry-probe-3). However, there's no explicit claim of full UI-to-API parity, and the openapi spec probe returned 404s, suggesting no comprehensive machine-readable API contract is easily discoverable. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full feature parity (e.g., dashboard/alert configuration via API), a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-accessible.
